header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner nor any intimation received. This petition was
body: filed in the year 2023 and is now fixed for hearing in the court. However, the prayer clause reflects that the petitioner is seeking constitution of joint enquiry committed including senior Judicial Officers to go through the entire record of BISE, Mirpurkhas regarding appointments and examination of BISE, Mirpurkhas.

From the perusal of the contents of the petition, it reflects that only the formal allegations were made and no any specific material was brought on record. Therefore, this petition being not maintainable, is hereby dismissed in limine. JUDGE JUDGE Salik
